intro.page1Title: See what electricity really costs you
intro.page1Text: The spot price on the news is only part of your bill. Elpuls adds your grid fee, energy tax and VAT, so you see the price you actually pay.
intro.breakdownCaption: A typical Swedish electricity bill, roughly
intro.breakdownA11y: A typical bill: about a quarter is the spot price, a quarter the grid fee, and half is energy tax and VAT.
intro.page2Title: Use electricity when it is cheap
intro.page2Text: Prices change every hour. Elpuls shows the cheapest hours and what the dishwasher, the washing machine or the car costs to run now or later.
intro.exampleFootnote: Example from a winter day in SE3.
intro.page3Text: Pro tells you why prices move and when to heat the house. Free for {{days}} days, then 39 kr a month.
